invariants.rationale: The method guarantees to return a HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>> instance.
The records list should not be null when passed to the commit action executor.
The write status list in HoodieWriteMetadata is expected to be non-null upon successful execution.
Sizes of collections in Java are always non-negative.
instantTime should be a valid non-empty string to represent a commit instant.
